user:
user create|list|delete|password|quota|bulk-create
  user create --email <e> [--display <d>] [--password-file <f> | --password-stdin]
  user list
  user delete <email>
  user password <email> (--new-password-file <f> | --new-password-stdin)
  user quota get <email>
  user quota set <email> <bytes>
  user bulk-create <file.csv>
webhook: webhook create --url <u> --events <e1,e2> | list | delete <id> | rotate-secret <id> | deliveries <id> | events
mailbox: mailbox retained | parity | preview <mailbox-id> | suspend|resume|detach-retain <mailbox-id> --generation N --reason TEXT | reconnect <mailbox-id> --generation N --target-user ID --evidence-kind local_user|identity_link --reason TEXT | purge-schedule <mailbox-id> --generation N --preview-digest HEX --approver-user ID --reason TEXT | purge-approve|purge-deny <approval-id> [--comment TEXT] | purge-cancel|purge-execute <purge-id> --reason TEXT
schema:
schema check [--json] | apply [--yes]
  (database schema version — forward migrations; requires DB_DSN env var)
bootstrap-admin:
bootstrap-admin --email <address> [--password-stdin | --password-file <0600-file>]
  (local first-boot authority; requires an owner/direct DB DSN and refuses after any user exists)
backup-db:
backup-db --bucket --access-key-file <0600-file> --secret-key-file <0600-file> [--dsn ] [--provider

] [--endpoint ] [--region ] (operator pg_dump -> backup bucket; DSN defaults to owner-first DB_*_DSN precedence; secrets also via BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY/BACKUP_SECRET_KEY env; argv secret flags refused)
restore:
restore --bucket <b> --access-key-file <0600-file> --secret-key-file <0600-file> [--control-socket <absolute-path>] [--type full|config|blobs] [--hashes csv] [--dsn <dsn>] [--dry-run] [--yes]
  (uses the local Unix control socket; type=full pg_restores the DB dump locally; secrets also via BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY/BACKUP_SECRET_KEY env; argv secret flags refused)
exchange-a0:
exchange-a0 registry --output <file> | validate --input <collector.json> | report --input <collector.json> --output <new-dir> [--locale zh-CN|en-US] [--pdf] | attest --kind handling|decision-use ... | verify-receipt --receipt <file> --report <file>
  (internal, customer-local A0/v0 discovery evidence; read-only and not importable as a product assessment)
exchange:
exchange assess preflight --offline [--json] | sample --output DIR [--json] | collect --input FILE --output DIR [--non-interactive] | inspect BUNDLE [--json] | report BUNDLE --output DIR [--format html,json] | import BUNDLE --project-id ID [--server URL] | diagnose BUNDLE --output FILE
  (V1A assessment only; replacement readiness is never implied)
upgrade: upgrade status | watch <intent-id> [--interval 2s] [--timeout 10m] | cancel <intent-id> --generation <n> --reason <text> | history | diagnostics <intent-id> --output <file>
ca:
ca list | create --name <n> [--state report_only|on|off] ... | update --id <id> ... | delete <id> | reorder <id1> <id2> ...
  ca export|import|apply|diff|plan|migrate|promote|init|why|simulate|coverage|doctor|install-pack|pack|signin-log
  ca validate|fmt|explain (offline, no server)
eap: eap list | create --name <n> --primary <tpl> ... | update --id <id> ... | delete <id> | apply [--id <id>] | reorder <id1> <id2> ...
scim:
scim create-token --name <n> --source <scim-source-key> [--expiry <dur>] [--deletion-policy soft|hard] | list-tokens
  (requires DB_DSN env var; source must be an active SCIM identity source)
smime:
smime import <manifest.csv> [--dry-run] [--default]
  (bulk-import users' own S/MIME certs at cutover; CSV cols: email,cert_path,key_path[,label]; requires DB_DSN + DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
storage:
storage status | migrate | verify
  (migrate target from STORAGE_PROVIDER env var)
device: device list | show <id> | events <id> | policy set|unset <id> <key> [value] | lock <id> | unlock <id> | wipe <id> [--level account|device]
policy: policy list | set <key> <value> | group list|set|unset <type> <id> <key> [value] | template save|load|list [name]
push:
push doctor | test --user <email>
  push doctor              validate each configured provider (VAPID/APNs cert/FCM SA/HMS); local, no server
  push test --user <email> send one test push to the user's devices (requires DB_DSN + DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
ad:
ad sync|sync-log|health
  ad sync                 trigger an immediate AD sync (POST /admin/ad/sync)
  ad sync-log             show recent sync log entries (GET /admin/ad/sync-log)
  ad health               show connectivity + last-sync status (GET /admin/ad/health)
ldap:
ldap sync|sync-log|health
  ldap sync                trigger an immediate LDAP sync (POST /admin/ldap/sync)
  ldap sync-log            show recent sync log entries (GET /admin/ldap/sync-log)
  ldap health              show connectivity + last-sync status (GET /admin/ldap/health)
identity:
identity inventory|source|people|conflict|transition|events|job|upgrade ... | doctor|diagnostics
  identity doctor [--source KEY]
  identity inventory export --output FILE
  identity source list
  identity people list
  identity conflict list
  identity transition list
  identity transition preview --person ID --reason TEXT [--idempotency-key UUID]
  identity transition start DRAFT --preview-digest HEX --reason TEXT [--approval-request ID]
  identity transition show ID
  identity transition export ID --output FILE
  identity events list
  identity job show|watch|cancel|results UUID
  identity diagnostics (--source KEY|--transition UUID) --since DURATION --reason TEXT --output FILE
  identity upgrade status|preflight|backfill|shadow|retirement-check
  identity upgrade canary plan|enable|disable --source KEY ...
  identity upgrade rollback --reason TEXT [--yes]
feature:
feature list|get|set
  feature list
  feature get <key>
  feature set <key> <on|off>
office:
office doctor|diagnostics|status | configure ... | qualify ... | activate ... | install ...
  (provider configuration and managed CODE installation remain separate from explicit routing activation)
sources:
sources status|doctor [--json] [--profile global|china|isolated|custom] [--collabora-registry HOST/REPO]
  (read-only Collabora/provider/Ubuntu source posture; never changes host files)
approval:
approval list [--consumer-type <ct>] | create --consumer-type <ct> --name <n> [--enabled] [--conditions <json>] [--requires-approval] [--approver-spec <json>] | update --id <id> [fields...] | delete <id> | reorder --consumer-type <ct> <id1> <id2> ...
  approval export [--consumer-type <ct>] | apply -f <file.json> | diff -f <file.json> | audit [--limit N] [--offset N]
role:
role list | create --name <n> --permissions <p1,p2> --reason <r> [--desc <d>] [--domain-scope <id>] | update --id <id> --reason <r> [fields...] | delete <id> --reason <r>
  role grant <email> --role <name> --reason <r> [--expires <RFC3339>] | revoke <email> --role <name> --reason <r>
  role export | apply -f <file.json> --reason <r> [--prune] | diff -f <file.json> [--prune]
